g.text: Human forecasts of AI solving open mathematics
Survey months are shown in the legend. Each respondent group has its own color.
are part of the all-expert sample.
They belong to the same survey wave.
This point is outside the graph.
ESPAI asks about AI solving a long-standing open math problem on its own. Millennium problems are examples.
LEAP asks about AI solving or substantially helping to solve a Millennium Prize Problem.
Markers show reported values. Lines join those values as guides. ESPAI 2023 has one reported point.
ESPAI averages fitted probability distributions. LEAP reports median respondent probabilities. The questions and methods differ.
Sources: AI Impacts ESPAI 2023/2024; FRI LEAP wave 2. Source data saved 30 Sep 2026.
